mapper.select: INSERT INTO novels (title, source_type, category_tags, char_count, form, chapter_count, author, platform, summary, run_id, story_settings, story_assets) VALUES (#{p.title}, #{p.sourceType}, #{p.categoryTags}::jsonb, #{p.charCount}, #{p.form}, #{p.chapterCount}, #{p.author}, #{p.platform}, #{p.summary}, #{p.runId}, #{p.storySettings}::jsonb, #{p.storyAssets}::jsonb) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE novels SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('protagonist', to_jsonb(#{protagonist})), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('protagonist', to_jsonb(#{protagonist}), 'cast', #{cast}::jsonb), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('truth', #{truth}::jsonb, 'v', 3), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('brief', #{brief}::jsonb, 'v', 3), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_settings = COALESCE(story_settings, '{"v":1}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('style_profile', #{styleProfile}::jsonb), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET char_count = #{charCount}, chapter_count = #{chapterCount}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = (COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb)) - 'protagonist' - 'cast' - 'truth' - 'brief', updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET story_assets = (COALESCE(story_assets, '{"v":1}'::jsonb)) - 'brief' - 'truth', updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novels SET chapter_count = #{chapterCount}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
